purpose: Public integrity attestation for the commercial portfolio. It binds the published valuation register, methodology and verified public project-site directory without disclosing private source code, private repository identities, private evidence artifacts or security-sensitive implementation detail.

verification.browserIntegrity: The portfolio renderer verifies the valuation register and methodology; the public-site directory enhancer independently recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the public project-site directory.
verification.valuationReconciliation: The public renderer assembles the current asset register, applies published overrides, recalculates asset-level analytical economics and compares aggregate values with the published portfolio totals.
verification.publicSiteDirectory: Only public project presentation surfaces with a confirmed successful GitHub Pages deployment and a matching canonical project identity are listed.
verification.existenceBoundary: The timestamped public publication and matching digests demonstrate existence and integrity of the public commercial record as published. They do not independently prove authorship, legal title, patent priority, source-code identity, scientific validity, security assurance, certified valuation or commercial outcome.

privacyBoundary: No private repository names, source code, private validation artifacts, credentials, customer data, internal security details or transaction-confidential material are included.
